scoring_justification: Checker recomputes Lyapunov exponent and winding number at selected hidden λ points from the agent's CSV, plus verifies integer-winding sequence patterns and gap/γ alignment.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden sample λ points, tolerances, and structural pattern definitions for recomputation
hidden_assets.source_provenance: synthetic fixture derived from the paper's parameter sweep λ∈[0,6] step 0.1
hidden_assets.generation_method: selected deterministic points covering transition regions of the two parameter cases
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: points are natural coverage of the domain; tolerances are based on expected numerical precision of independent implementations

outputs.description: Scored artifact for the bounded case. The checker will recompute the Lyapunov exponent and winding number at sampled λ values and compare to the agent's values within tolerance, and verify the re-entrant sequence of ν.

Scored artifact for the unbounded case. The checker will recompute the Lyapunov exponent and winding number at sampled λ values and compare to the agent's values within tolerance, and verify the re-entrant sequence of ν.

output_contract.notes: The observed re-entrant phase transitions are verified via the sequence of winding numbers (type-I for bounded, type-II for unbounded) and the zero-crossings of the Lyapunov exponent at topological transitions, in addition to pointwise recomputations.
